metadata.nasdaq_note: Using Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) as Nasdaq 100 proxy for longer history (correlation >0.95)
metadata.methodology: Hybrid: fund NAV returns where available (real dividends+fees already included); index returns with 0.85%/yr fee drag for pre-fund periods. Subscription 0.12% and redemption 0.5-1.5% applied separately in frontend simulations.

fee_model.note: 指数阶段已扣减月均费率。基金净值阶段已含实际费费。定投再平衡需另外计算申购/赎回费。

metadata.comparison_note: Compared to v1 (index+estimated dividends), this version deducts real mgmt+custody fees and uses actual fund total returns where available.
